headline.purpose: Player names and highest local headings.

display.purpose: Speed, gear, and race position only.

display-compact.purpose: Gear and player position in constrained panels.

display-mobile.purpose: Large telemetry values on narrow screens.

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Primary telemetry panel with tonal depth and a quiet hairline.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#14171c; color:#fff; border:1px solid #242830; border-radius:14px; padding:18px; } .ds-card h2 { margin:0; font:700 12px/1.3 Satoshi,Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin:8px 0 0; color:#969da8; font:400 13px/1.45 Satoshi,Inter,sans-serif; }

components.name: Player Panel
components.description: Selectable two-player summary that opens technical detail.
components.css: .ds-player { width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; background:#101217; color:#fff; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; padding:18px; text-align:left; font-family:Satoshi,Inter,sans-serif; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-player:hover { background:#1a1e24; } .ds-player:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1c69d4; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-position { font-size:36px; font-weight:700; } .ds-player strong,.ds-player small { display:block; } .ds-player small { margin-top:4px; color:#969da8; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; background:#0fa336; color:#000; border-radius:999px; padding:2px 8px; font:700 9px/1.3 Satoshi,Inter,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:1px; } .ds-status span { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Quiet destination control with a tonal active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; color:#969da8; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 12px; font:600 11px/1.3 Satoshi,Inter,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav:hover { background:#1a1e24; color:#fff; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1c69d4; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: Compact charcoal field for driver and session filtering.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:#969da8; font:500 11px/1.3 Satoshi,Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-field select { appearance:auto; background:#14171c; color:#fff; border:1px solid #30343c; border-radius:6px; padding:7px 10px; font:400 12px/1.3 Satoshi,Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-field select:hover { border-color:#464c57; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1c69d4; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: This interface should feel like a modern race broadcast built around two competitors: immediate enough for spectators, precise enough for the players, and calm enough to scan throughout a full session. The two human players and the changing story between them are the primary visual layer. Whole-field standings, technical telemetry, and historical detail remain accessible as supporting layers. The system uses a dark canvas because it is commonly viewed on a gaming display during a live session, where low glare and stable data colors matter. Minimalism comes from hierarchy, consolidation, and progressive disclosure—not from removing useful telemetry. It explicitly rejects an overcrowded engineering console, a flashy arcade HUD, and a generic admin template.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors communicate identity or live state; they do not decorate inactive panels.

rules.name: The Broadcast Scan Rule
rules.body: A viewer should distinguish player, position, comparison, and state from typography alone before color is considered.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Use a neighboring surface token before adding a border, and a border before considering a shadow.

dos: Place the two human players and their changing competitive relationship before whole-field detail.
Retain useful telemetry through progressive disclosure and compact secondary rows.
Use semantic colors for live states and pair those colors with text.
Keep motion between 150–250ms, tied to selection, status, or live value changes, with reduced-motion support.
donts: Recreate an overcrowded engineering console or a generic admin template.
Box every metric, nest cards, or use separators where spacing and alignment are enough.
Use arcade-style glow, decorative glass, gradient text, or animated ornament.
Use colored side-stripe borders on rows or panels.
Hide useful race information in pursuit of information-light minimalism.
